notes.title: You can try the next Hades patch in the new test branch now
notes.notes:
Do you find yourself daydreaming about Hades a lot? As in, what might developers Supergiant Games have up their sleeves for the next patch - that kind of thing. Well, now you can find out - there's a Hades test branch available now, and it has some upcoming enhancements to the lovely action RPG game ready for your perusal.

The Hades test branch is where Supergiant will stage its upcoming patches, and the version on there now includes two new decorative themes for Hades' lobby, some new voice lines for several of the characters, and a bunch of bugfixes. Those fixes include stability enhancements, the mouse lock setting not working with multiple monitor setups, the Well Stocked achievement not popping, and one that made poor little Dusa get stuck when she tries to fly away.

Our hero Zagreus, as well as Charon and Minotaur, have new voice lines, and lines for Nyx and Dusa have been fixed so you hear the ones you're supposed to hear now. A couple issues that were preventing story events and their associated voiceover lines from playing have also been repaired in the test version of Hades.

notes.title: Dive Into the Blood Price Update!
notes.notes:
Our [i]god-like[/i] rogue-like dungeon crawler, [b][i]Hades[/i][/b], expands in a big way in our new Major Update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/884a8ac3df8b9555dfcfea19fbc3d8b524cad76c.png[/img]
[h1]About the Update[/h1]
[i][b]Hades[/b][/i] becomes a bigger, more varied experience than ever with new content across the board!
[list]
[*] The Stygian Boatman, [b]Charon[/b], is finally unmasked, and has new inventory in stock in his shops & Wells [i](plus  a surprise or two)[/i]!

[*] Discover [b][i]three[/i] new Legendary Weapon Aspects[/b], including the Shield's [b]Aspect of Beowulf[/b] and the Bow's [b]Aspect of Rama[/b]!

[*] Get new [b]Boons[/b] from each Olympian, including [b]Duo Boons[/b] for every pairing -- plus, new [b]Daedalus Hammer[/b] upgrades for each weapon!

[*] Take on new [b]foes[/b], [b]mini-bosses[/b], even a [b]hidden boss[/b]! Beware the [b]Wretched Sneak[/b], [b]Doomstone[/b], [b]Dracon[/b], and other dangers.

[*] Experience [b]new story events with almost every character[/b], with more than 3,500 new voice lines added for this update!
[/list]
This update also features a huge amount of new-and-improved art and audio, not to mention a totally revamped code base that should make the game run even faster and smoother for many players. You'll be able to get closer than ever to the game's big cast of characters as you gear up for the true ending, coming in our v1.0 Launch.

[h1]How to Get It[/h1]
[b]The Blood Price Update[/b] is a free, automatic download as part of the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i]. If you've come directly to this post, check out the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/
Once you've downloaded the update, you may need to restart your Steam client. In the off chance the game isn't working properly for you after the update, please try verifying the game files:
[list]
[*]Right-click on Hades in your Steam Library
[*]Select 'Properties...', then select the 'Local Files' tab
[*]Select 'Verify Integrity of Game Files...'
[/list]
This may alleviate any issues. If you run into [b]any technical issues[/b], please check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1145360/discussions/1/1753520467359788156/][b]Technical Support FAQ[/b][/url] for solutions.

[h1]Patch Notes & Discord[/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/newshub/app/1145360/view/2481994871656576741]Full patch notes[/url] are available here on Steam, in the game client, and [url=discord.gg/Supergiant]our official Discord[/url], where you can join a welcoming community of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] players and Supergiant fans. This update also includes a significant update to our Development Roadmap, with these highlights:
 
[h1]Dev Roadmap Update - June 2020[/h1]
You can always see our latest Development Roadmap right in the game client. We wanted to share highlights from our latest update here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/9384d2af4ab1936688293f6f3d9f4a5c12e0d9dd.png[/img]

In our third and latest Major Update this year, we made big, important under-the-hood changes to our code base, improving performance and multiplatform capability. We also added new content pretty much across the board.

[b]What's Next:[/b]
Our next big step is to exit Early Access for the v1.0 Launch of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], coming later this year! It will include the true ending of the story, plus many additional finishing touches.

[b]Release Date & Platforms:[/b]
As of this writing, we don't yet have a more-specific date for our v1.0 Launch, other than 'later this year'. We also can't yet confirm any additional platforms. Thank you for your patience, and check here or social media for the latest news.

[b]High Priority Tasks:[/b]
These are the big-ticket items we have to take care of before we can exit Early Access for our v1.0 Launch:

[list]
[*][b]Game Ending[/b]: Though we wish to keep the details a secret, we're continuing to work on content for the game's true ending.

[*][b]Polishing & Content Completion[/b]: We have some other additional content pieces in the works, plus final fixes and improvements.

[*][b]Multiplatform Development[/b]: Each platform we support requires special care and attention, both in features and optimizations.

[*][b]Localization[/b]: We're working with professional and community translators to ensure the game is fully translated for our v1.0 Launch.
[/list]

[i][b]Hades[/b][/i] has now been in development for about three years. The very first decision we made on the project was to make it an Early Access game, which we could build in partnership with our community. We also wanted to prove that Early Access development could be compatible with our approach to making games. We couldn't be happier with how the experiment has gone. Your feedback has made this game so much better than we could have on our own, so keep telling us what you think. Onward to our v1.0 Launch!

notes.title: The Blood Price Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[i][b]Hades[/b][/i] is in Early Access, which means we're actively working on it based on our plans and your feedback. [h1]Early Access Patch 044: The BLOOD PRICE Update - June 23, 2020[/h1]
Our third [b]Major Update [/b] of the year has officially arrived, and it's our biggest [i]ever[/i], chock-full of new content across the board!! [h1]Highlights[/h1]
•  [b]New Boss Fight[/b]: see if you can find this dangerous new encounter, and reap the rewards
•  [b]New Legendary Aspects[/b]: discover the hidden forms of the [b]Bow[/b], [b]Shield[/b], and [b]Rail[/b]

[h1]Engine & Tech[/h1]

notes.title: Hit Up The Night Night Update!
notes.notes:
Our god-like rogue-like dungeon crawler, [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], is bigger and better than ever with the advent of our tenth Major Update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/31b19e6f71c84bebaceeaeef9911c9b6c0718274.jpg[/img]
[h1]About the Update[/h1]
The Nighty Night Update lets you get your mitts on a fierce new weapon, customize your playstyle with all-new Talents, and delve even deeper into the story.
[list]
[*]Harness the [b]Twin Fists of Malphon[/b], & pulverize your foes with fists of fury! Features three unique Aspects to unlock!

[*]Choose from all-new [b]Mirror of Night Talents[/b], opening up completely new playstyles & powerful builds!

[*]Discover the [b]Stygian Blade[/b]'s legendary [b]Aspect of Arthur[/b], & defend yourself with its holy might!

[*]Break into the [b]Admin Chamber[/b] in the House of Hades, & have a look at your [b]Permanent Record[/b]!

[*]New chambers, story events, artwork, & much, much more!
[/list]
This update also introduces a slew of graphical enhancements, improving the clarity of the action without sacrificing the spectacular look. Plus, you can learn more about Nyx, incarnate of night, and her vital role in the Underworld, and deepen your relationships with characters such as Orpheus, Artemis, and Zeus.

[h1]How to Get It[/h1]
[b]The Nighty Night Update[/b] is a free, automatic download as part of the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i]. If you've come directly to this post, check out the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/
Once you've downloaded the update, you may need to restart your Steam client. In the off chance the game isn't working properly for you after the update, please try verifying the game files:[list][*]Right-click on Hades in your Steam Library
[*]Select 'Properties...', then select the 'Local Files' tab
[*]Select 'Verify Integrity of Game Files...'
[/list]
This may alleviate any issues.

[h1]Patch Notes & Discord[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1145360/announcements/detail/1715247522485727717]Full patch notes[/url] are available here on Steam, in the game client, and [url=discord.gg/Supergiant]our official Discord[/url], where you can join a welcoming community of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] players and Supergiant fans. This update also includes a big update to our Development Roadmap, with these highlights:
 
[h1]Dev Roadmap Update - March 2020[/h1]
You can always see our latest Development Roadmap right in the game client. We wanted to share highlights from our latest update here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/e678c4844c526f4359b65d0c9464b2e02441d8c7.jpg[/img]
Our next Major Update is slated for June. This is a longer wait than our previous updates, and for the first time, we are not prepared to commit to a specific launch date (yet). The reason is, we need this time to complete a significant technical update to our code base, which will yield two benefits:
[list]
[*][b]Multiplatform Capability[/b]: Our updated code base will let us bring [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] to additional platforms, which has always been one of our goals (We expect to bring [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] to other platforms once our Early Access is complete sometime this year; we haven't decided on all those platforms just yet)

[*][b]Improved Performance[/b]: Our updated code base should make [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] run better on more system configurations
[/list]
These benefits are important to the future of this game, even if they do not have an immediate, visible impact for all our Early Access players. We really appreciate your patience and understanding as we execute this significant bit of under-the-hood work.
 
[b]Technical Beta[/b]: Prior to the official launch of our next Major Update in June, we are planning to have a technical beta for our updated code base. Details to come via Twitter, Discord, and Steam.
 
[b]June Update Preview[/b]: While our engineering team will be busy with our code base, our content team will be busy polishing many aspects of the game, and creating new Boons, Well of Charon items, Weapon Aspects, story content, music, and more. So, while our next Major Update may not be loaded with tons of new features, it should still be content-rich, while putting us in a good spot for continued development.
 
[b]Release Date & Platforms[/b]: The launch date and platforms for v1.0 of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] are still to be determined. However, we can safely say our next Major Update, slated for June 2020, will not be the last between now and our v1.0 later this year (when we exit Early Access).

Until next time, thank you for playing, and good luck getting out of hell!

We expect to keep adding features, characters, weapons, foes, powers, environments, and more, while expanding the story and fine-tuning all aspects of the experience. Here are our latest patch note!

[b]EDIT -- Follow-up Patches[/b]
[i]We always release at least a couple of follow-up patches after each Major Update, to respond to feedback, fix remaining issues, and make additional improvements.[/i]

[h1]Early Access Patch 040: The NIGHTY NIGHT Update - March 10, 2020[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/b23fd2371f17e7a6a79e7e97de7a27788d90eaa8.jpg[/img]
This [b]Major Update [/b]opens up even more ways to battle out of hell, with a powerful new weapon, new weapon Aspects, and lots more story to sink your teeth into! As always, we will be closely monitoring feedback and are planning on at least a couple of follow-up patches. Thank you very much for playing!

[b]Note:[/b] 📢 indicates a change inspired by community feedback!

[h1]Highlights[/h1]
•  [b]Malphon, the Twin Fists[/b]: pummel your foes into the ground with this furious close-quarters weapon
•  [b]Mirror of Night Rework[/b]: now with [i]twice [/i]the Talents, inviting more choices to fit your playstyle
•  [b]Aspect of Arthur[/b]: wield the might of [b]Holy Excalibur [/b]with this legendary Aspect of the [b]Stygian Blade[/b]
•  [b]Improved Visual Effects[/b]: we've made frenetic combat easier to parse without compromising the [i]oomph[/i]
•  [b]New Pact of Punishment Conditions[/b]: see if you can survive [b]Benefits Package [/b]and [b]Routine Inspection[/b]
•  [b]Administrative Chamber[/b]: access your [b]Permanent Record [/b]beyond a locked door in the [b]House[/b]
•  [b]New House of Hades Events[/b]: the god of the dead's residence is livelier than ever
•  [b]Expanded Story[/b]: hours of added narrative featuring Nyx, Chaos, Artemis, Zeus, and more

[h1]Infernal Arms, Aspects, & Abilities[/h1]
•  [b]Twin Fists[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Unlock earlier weapons to reveal this [i](once you return from an escape attempt)[/i]
•  [b]Twin Fists (Zagreus Aspect)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Gain attack speed and dodge chance
•  [b]Twin Fists (Talos Aspect)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Drag foes to you with the power of the [b]Magnetic Cutter[/b]
•  [b]Twin Fists (Demeter Aspect)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Obliterate foes with the power of the [b]Giga Cutter[/b]
•  [b]Stygian Blade (Arthur Aspect)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Seek [b]Nyx [/b]to learn more [i](unlock Guan Yu and Blade aspects first)[/i]
•  [b]Eternal Spear (Guan Yu Aspect)[/b]: Spin attack now bounces off obstacles rather than passing through
•  [b]Adamant Rail[/b]: increased accuracy; now the sixth weapon to be unlocked, after the [b]Twin Fists[/b]
•  Added one more frame of invulnerability to the [b]Dash [/b][i](you now are fully invulnerable until you can move)[/i]

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
•  Reduced base offering rate of [b]Legendary [/b]and [b]Duo [/b]Boons; a new [b]Mirror [/b]Talent lets you boost this
•  [b]Huge Catch (Poseidon)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Increases chance of finding fishing points
•  [b]Holy Shield (Athena)[/b]: fixed [b]Evergreen Acorn (Eurydice) [/b]activating at the same time when you are hit
•  [b]True Shot (Artemis)[/b]: reduced damage scaling from improved rarity
📢 [b]Unhealthy Fixation (Aphrodite)[/b]: can now be offered if you have [b]Broken Resolve[/b]; fixed issues where Charmed damage bonus did not expire
•  [b]Battle Rage (Ares)[/b]: expires after first hit from [b]Aspect of Zeus [/b]Throw special; no longer expires when recalling the [b]Spear[/b]'s Throw special
📢 [b]Urge to Kill (Ares)[/b]: improved scaling from [b]Poms[/b]
•  [b]Snow Burst (Demeter)[/b]: now correctly fires at your position while loading ammo using [b]Aspect of Hera[/b]; no longer hits through obstacles
📢 [b]Mistral Dash (Demeter)[/b]: increased damage
📢 [b]Atrophic (Chaos)[/b]: fixed issues causing incorrect adjustments to Life Total
•  [b]Roiling (Chaos)[/b]: duration no longer reduced by Boss encounters [i](since it does not affect those encounters)[/i]
•  [b]Auto Reload (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Regenerate Bloodstones faster [i](if you have a certain Mirror talent)[/i]
•  [b]Bad News (Hermes)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Deal bonus Cast damage to foes [i]without [/i]Cast ammo in them [i](if you have a certain Mirror talent)[/i]
•  [b]Greater Recall (Hermes)[/b]: now requires first having one of Hermes' Cast-affecting Boons
•  [b]Flurry Shot (Hermes)[/b]: reduced power scaling from improved rarity
•  [b]Quick Reload (Hermes)[/b]: increased power scaling at Heroic rarity

[h1]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/h1]
📢 [b]Double Nova (Blade)[/b]: reduced penalty to damage radius
📢 [b]Cursed Slash (Blade)[/b]: reduced penalty to Life Total
📢 [b]Charged Volley (Bow)[/b]: increased minimum range; no longer offered while using [b]Aspect of Chiron[/b]
•  [b]Relentless Barrage (Bow)[/b]: fixed an issue where it sometimes stopped working with [b]Aspect of Chiron[/b]
•  [b]Chain Shot (Bow)[/b]: shots no longer bounce off of invisible Chamber boundaries
•  [b]Minotaur Rush (Shield)[/b]: increased Bull Rush Power Shot damage
📢 [b]Charged Shot (Shield)[/b]: increased minimum range
•  [b]Explosive Return (Shield)[/b]: slightly reduced damage
•  [b]Exploding Launcher (Rail)[/b]: slightly reduced damage
•  [b]Cluster Bomb (Rail)[/b]: adjusted firing pattern
•  [b]Hazard Bomb (Rail)[/b]: now fires on press [i](rather than on release)[/i]; fixed interaction with [b]Inescapable Blast[/b]
•  [b]Spread Fire (Rail)[/b]: [b]reworked[/b]; now fires as a single, powerful blast
•  [b]Long Knuckle (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Attacks have improved range and damage
•  [b]Rolling Knuckle (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Attack combo ends in a powerful hook punch
•  [b]Concentrated Knuckle (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Successive attacks against the same foe deal more damage
•  [b]Breaching Cross (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Your Dash-Strike pierces foes and deals bonus damage to Armor
•  [b]Explosive Upper (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Your Dash-Special [i](unique to Twin Fists) [/i]deals bonus area damage
•  [b]Rush Kick (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Dash toward foes with a powerful kick
•  [b]Flying Cutter (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Hold Special for a stronger, longer range strike
•  [b]Draining Cutter (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Slay foes with your Cutter special to restore some Life
•  [b]Quake Cutter (Fists)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Deal area damage while landing from your Cutter special

[h1]Foes & Encounters[/h1]
•  [b]'Trial of the Gods'[/b]: updated many effects from spurned gods; no longer occur in smaller chambers
•  [b]Thanatos[/b]: reduced appearance rate in [b]Tartarus[/b]; removed [b]Flame Wheels [/b]from appearing in these fights
📢 Larger chambers in [b]Asphodel [/b]now only appear later in the region
•  [b]Bone Hydra[/b]: a wider variety of heads can appear [i](note that no new types have been added)[/i]
📢 [b]Exalted Longspear[/b]: attack visual more closely matches its hit box
📢 [b]Splitter[/b]: updated pattern of split-firing projectiles [i](it should look better)[/i]
•  [b]The Minotaur[/b]: updated spin attack, specific to the effect of [b]Extreme Measures (Pact)[/b]
📢 [b]Theseus[/b]: can no longer invoke Demeter's aid before you have met her
📢 [b]Crawler[/b]: Elite variant no longer appears, although...
•  ...added a terrifying new mini-boss encounter to the [b]Temple of Styx[/b]...

[h1]Mirror of Night[/h1]
•  [b]Reworked! [/b]More choices, improved usability, reduced total Darkness cost; in more detail:
•  Added a new [i]flip-side Talent [/i]for each Talent! Only one Talent per pair can be active at a time
•  Removed ability to subtract ranks in a given talent; added a full Darkness refund option
•  Talents are no longer all visible at the start of the game; they are now unlocked two rows at a time
•  Later Talents cost less Darkness; if you had more invested than is now required, it has been refunded. Total Darkness required to max [i]all [/i]Talents is less than before [i](when there were half as many Talents)[/i]
•  [b]Fiery Presence[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Deal more damage vs. undamaged foes
•  [b]Dark Regeneration[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Recover health when you collect Darkness
•  [b]Stubborn Defiance[/b]: [b]new! [/b]A single [b]Death Defiance [/b]effect that replenishes in each Chamber
•  [b]Ruthless Reflex[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Dash just before taking damage for bonus damage and dodge chance
•  [b]Stygian Soul[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Your Cast ammo regenerates automatically [i](instead of dropping from foes)[/i]
•  [b]Golden Touch[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Earn money between Underworld regions based on how much you have
•  [b]High Confidence[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Deal bonus damage while your Life Total is high
•  [b]Abyssal Blood[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Foes with Cast ammo in them move slower and deal less damage
•  [b]Family Favorite[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Deal bonus damage for each different Olympian whose Boons you have
•  [b]Olympian Legacy[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Improves chance of finding [b]Duo [/b]or [b]Legendary [/b]Boons
•  [b]Gods' Chosen[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Improves chance of finding chambers with Boons, Hammers, or Poms
•  [b]Fated Persuasion[/b]: [b]new! [/b]You can randomly alter Boon and Well of Charon choices offered
•  [i]Note: We have plans to do even more with the Darkness resource in future updates[/i]

[h1]Keepsakes & Items[/h1]
•  [b]Lucky Tooth (Skelly)[/b]: reduced healing at higher ranks [i](bringing it in line with other defensive Keepsakes)[/i]
•  [b]Broken Spearpoint (Fallen Warrior)[/b]: fixed issues with it not working against some [b]Final Boss [/b]attacks
•  [b]Black Shawl (Nyx)[/b]: [b]reworked[/b]; now gives bonus damage vs. undamaged foes and while backstabbing
📢 [b]Companion Mort (Thanatos)[/b]: no longer blockable by shield-bearing foes
•  [b]Companion Rib (Skelly)[/b]: increased resistance to wall-slam damage
•  [b]Companion Shady (Sisyphus)[/b]: resource drops now affected by certain Boons; reduced money drops
•  [b]Touch of Styx (Well)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Improves healing from [b]Stubborn Defiance[/b]
•  [b]Touch of Styx Dark (Fallen Warrior)[/b]: [b]new! [/b]A superior version of the above
•  [b]Trove Tracker (Well)[/b]: no longer offered in the [b]Temple of Styx [/b][i](Lord Hades wouldn't put troves there)[/i]

[h1]Pact of Punishment[/h1]
📢 [b]Budget Cuts[/b]: cut from game; replaced with...
📢 [b]Routine Inspection[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Disables [b]Mirror of Night [/b]talents, three at a time from the bottom
📢 [b]Benefits Package[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Gives Dire [i](a.k.a Armored) [/i]foes an assortment of nasty Perks:
•  [b]Shifter[/b]: teleports around from time to time
•  [b]Bruiser[/b]: extra armor
•  [b]Puller[/b]: surrounded by a field that pulls you in
•  [b]Savior[/b]: intermittently makes nearby foes briefly invulnerable
•  [b]Slugger[/b]: hits harder
•  [b]Speeder[/b]: moves and attacks faster
•  [b]Linker[/b]: links to other foes via a continuous beam that damages you
•  [b]Cloner[/b]: summons 1-Life copies of itself
•  [b]Burner[/b]: spews molten puddles
•  [b]Seeker[/b]: ranged attacks track you
•  [b]Popper[/b]: bursts into Exalted Shades that self-destruct
•  The Condition previously called [i]No Choice [/i]now is called [b]Approval Process[/b]

[h1]Permanent Record[/h1]
•  [b]new! [/b]Added a screen summarizing each of your escape attempts; find it in the [b]House[/b]'s locked chamber
•  [i]Note: This is a first-pass version of this screen, which we expect to continue improving in subsequent Major Updates[/i]

[h1]House Contractor[/h1]
•  Added items specific to certain subplots...

[h1]Fated List of Minor Prophecies[/h1]
•  [b]Whence Night and Darkness Came[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Nyx and Chaos shall be reunited
•  [b]Musician and Muse[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Orpheus and Eurydice shall be reunited
•  [b]The Holy King[/b]: [b]new! [/b]The Aspect of Arthur shall reach the surface
•  [b]Slashed Benefits[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Foes with all [b]Benefits Package [/b]Perks shall be slain
•  [b]Denizens of the Deep[/b]: [b]new! [/b]A variety of fish shall be caught
•  [b]Dark Reflections[/b]: [b]new! [/b]Successful escapes shall be completed using all [b]Mirror [/b]Talents
•  [b]End to Torment[/b]: aiding [b]Sisyphus [/b]is more involved than before [i](if you haven't done this yet)[/i]
•  Updated requirements to fulfill several other [b]Prophecies [/b][i](won't affect you if you've already fulfilled them)[/i]

[h1]Level Design & Environments[/h1]
•  Added two new chambers to [b]Asphodel[/b]
📢 It is easier to reliably dash across gaps in several [b]Temple of Styx [/b]chambers
📢 Updated, clearer cover layout in the [b]Final Boss [/b]chamber
•  The lounge's kitchen area in the [b]House of Hades [/b]is easier to get to
•  You can now get into one of the locked chambers in the [b]House of Hades[/b]...
•  Other minor fixes and improvements to various chambers

•  Updated main menu based on new Major Update
•  Added new portraits and character model for [b]Nyx[/b]
•  Added new character model and animations for [b]Hypnos[/b]
•  Added new animations for [b]Dusa[/b]
•  Added some new animations for [b]Lord Hades[/b]
•  Added unique art, animation, and VFX for the [b]Twin Fists [/b]and its [b]Aspects[/b]

•  Extended [b]Affinity Gauges [/b]for [b]Nyx[/b], [b]Chaos[/b], [b]Artemis[/b], and [b]Zeus [/b][i](you can give them more gifts)[/i]

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]

[i]'Nyx, whom the Romans called Nox, is a scarcely personified abstraction... Alone she spawned a large and generally unpleasant brood that included Moros (Doom), Thanatos (Death), Hypnos (Sleep), the Fates, and Nemesis.' [/i][b]~Crowell's Handbook of Classical Mythology [/b](E. Tripp)

This patch includes more localized content, balance changes, fixes, and improvements for last week's [b]Long Winter Update[/b], as we shift focus to our next [b]Major Update[/b]. Until then, thank you for playing!!

[h1]General Gameplay[/h1]
•  Reduced prices of [b]Boons [/b]sold by [b]Charon[/b]
📢 [b]Titan Blood [/b]sold at the [b]Wretched Broker [/b]now yields more [b]Gemstones[/b]

[h1]Infernal Arms, Aspects, & Abilities[/h1]
•  [b]Shield of Chaos[/b]: slightly reduced Bull Rush charge-up time [i](to how it was before the Long Winter Update)[/i]
•  [b]Adamant Rail[/b]: increased autolock radius while using gamepad

[h1]Boons & Blessings[/h1]
•  Reduced offering rate of 'Exchange' Boons
•  Reduced offering rate for [b]Olympian Aid [/b]Boons [i](in general, they should appear less early and often)[/i]
•  [b]Divine Dash (Athena)[/b]: slightly increased Deflect duration [i](still less than before the Long Winter Update)[/i]
•  [b]Proud Bearing (Athena)[/b]: improved scaling from [b]Poms[/b]
•  [b]Holy Shield (Athena)[/b]: increased duration of Deflect revenge effect
•  [b]Curse of Pain (Ares)[/b]: fixed an issue causing this not to scale correctly with improved rarity
•  [b]Urge to Kill (Ares)[/b]: effect now can scale with [b]Poms[/b]
📢 [b]Aphrodite's Call[/b]: no longer blockable by shield-bearing foes; no longer stopped by [b]Final Boss [/b]urns
📢 [b]Artemis' Call[/b]: no longer stopped by by [b]Final Boss [/b]urns
📢 [b]Crystal Beam (Demeter)[/b]: increased tracking speed
•  [b]Killing Freeze (Demeter)[/b]: improved scaling from rarity
•  [b]Rare Crop (Demeter)[/b]: slightly reduced appearance rate
•  [b]Demeter's Aid[/b]: increased speed at which winter vortex reaches full size
📢 [b]Blizzard Shot (Demeter x Poseidon)[/b]: increased damage
•  [b]Defiance (Chaos)[/b]: increased appearance rate

notes.title: Brace for the Long Winter Update
notes.notes:
Our [i]god-like[/i] rogue-like dungeon crawler, [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], is ringing in the new year with a Major Update brimming with surprises that should perk you right up as you battle out of hell!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/9a37580088ddd8e8c62f2b47f5f2dc73084ac8ab.png[/img]

[h1]About the Update[/h1]
[b]The Long Winter Update[/b] introduces one of the eldest and most powerful Olympians, as well as a couple of big, new surprises, new story events, new upgrades, new artwork... let's get to the highlights, already![list][*]Meet [b]Demeter[/b], Goddess of Seasons, who joins the Olympian fray, granting her powers over desolation and cold

[*]Unlock the [b]Rod of Fishing[/b], and capture all sorts of foul river-dwelling denizens of the Underworld

[*]Discover the [b]Eternal Spear[/b]'s fated [b]Aspect of Guan Yu[/b], revealing more of the secrets of your legendary weapons

[*][b]Underworld Renovations Galore[/b]! The new and improved [b]House Contractor[/b] has scores of new decorations available

[*]New [b]Daedalus Hammer Upgrades[/b], [b]Story Events[/b], Improved [b]Boon Info[/b] Screen, and more![/list]
[i][b]Hades[/b][/i] already offers dozens or even hundreds of hours of kinetic action and seemingly never-ending story featuring dozens of colorful, fully voiced characters, and the rich worldbuilding Supergiant is known for. With the Long Winter Update, many more story details finally come to light, even as the breadth of activities in the game continues to expand. [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] is slated to exit Early Access sometime later this year.
 
[h1]How to Get It[/h1]
[b]The Long Winter Update[/b] is a free, automatic download as part of the Early Access development of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i]. If you've come directly to this post, check out the game here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1145360/Hades/
Once you've downloaded the update, you may need to restart your Steam client. In the off chance the game isn't working properly for you after the update, please try verifying the game files:[list][*]Right-click on Hades in your Steam Library
[*]Select 'Properties...', then select the 'Local Files' tab
[*]Select 'Verify Integrity of Game Files...'
[/list]
This may alleviate any issues.

[h1]Patch Notes & Discord[/h1]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1145360/announcements/detail/3332035374027349277]Full patch notes[/url] are available here on Steam, in the game client, and our [url=http://discord.gg/Supergiant]official Discord[/url], where we invite you to join a welcoming, international community of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i] players and Supergiant fans.

Thank you so much for playing! Player feedback heavily informs our updates and is always on our mind. We're excited to press onward in development with you, and wish you good luck getting out of hell!
